name: Memory Manager help
description: Help mode entries for the Memory Manager plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Memory Manager
entries.text: Every place Claude memory lives, in one list: what each file is, whether sessions load it at start, and which parts of the app read and write it. Pick a file to see its readers and writers, view, edit, move or delete it (every change keeps the old text as a version), or open it as a tab you can split and float. The Chunks panel lists the chunked store sessions load from; Session start shows what a session loads first.

entries.title: View
entries.text: Browse (big file column), Read (slim column, wide reading), Write (editor and live preview side by side) or IDE (dense tree, editor tabs, outline and references docked on the right).

entries.title: Pane layouts
entries.text: Lays the open tabs out on one of the layout presets (two side by side, three columns, a grid…), with a preview first.

entries.title: Reload the file list
entries.text: Reads the files again, to pick up files another session just saved.

entries.title: Column
entries.text: Files lists every .md file by scope; Snippets are ready pieces to drag into a file; Wizards make new Claude files.

entries.title: Find files
entries.text: Shows only files whose name or path has every word you type.

entries.title: Search inside files
entries.text: Also matches the words inside each file, with a snippet of where.

entries.title: References
entries.text: The files this one points to (imports, links and paths). Tap one to open it beside this file.

entries.title: Edit
entries.text: Lets you change this file. Off = read only, so nothing changes by accident.

entries.title: Show
entries.text: Preview renders the file; Split shows the editor and the live preview side by side (one at a time on a phone); Edit shows only the editor.

entries.title: Save
entries.text: Saves now. It only saves when nobody else changed the file since you opened it; otherwise it asks you to reload first.

entries.title: Find and replace
entries.text: Finds text in this file and replaces one match or all of them.

entries.title: Version history
entries.text: Every save keeps the text it replaced. View an older version or restore it (the current text is kept too, so a restore can be undone).

entries.title: Context view
entries.text: This file and everything it references, as branches, with about how many tokens each part costs and the share of the whole.

entries.title: Reload from disk
entries.text: Reads the file again (drops unsaved changes after asking).

entries.title: Markdown toolbar
entries.text: Headings, bold, italic, strikethrough, code, lists, checklists, quotes, links, code blocks, tables and dividers. Ctrl+B, Ctrl+I, Ctrl+E, Ctrl+K, Ctrl+S and Ctrl+F work too.

entries.title: Depth
entries.text: How many levels of references the context view follows.

entries.title: What for
entries.text: Shows only the wizards for one purpose: instructions, rules, persona, tracking, skills or docs.

entries.title: Scope
entries.text: Where the new file goes: Project (an app's folder), Claude (the hub's Claude files) or Repo.

entries.title: Hub project
entries.text: Which project's Claude files the new file joins; Shared reaches every project.

entries.title: Create
entries.text: Makes the file (never over one that already exists) and opens it ready to edit.

entries.title: Files
entries.text: Every .md file by scope and category. Tap a file to open it; the arrow before it shows what it references.

entries.title: Snippets
entries.text: Ready pieces of Markdown (rules, threads rows, build steps, lists, code). Drag one into an editor or tap it.

entries.title: Wizards
entries.text: Make a new Claude file (CLAUDE.md, rules, persona, threads log, skill, instructions, decision, README) from a short form.

entries.title: All wizards
entries.text: Back to the list of wizards.

entries.title: Reload
entries.text: Someone saved this file after you opened it. Reload reads their version (your unsaved text goes, so copy it first).

entries.title: Copy my text
entries.text: Copies your unsaved text, so you can paste it back after reloading.

entries.title: Replace with
entries.text: The text that replaces each match.

entries.title: Replace all
entries.text: Replaces every match in this file at once.

entries.title: Close find
entries.text: Hides the find and replace bar.

entries.title: What Claude loads
entries.text: Follows only @imports, the files Claude actually loads with this one, so the token count is what a session pays.

entries.title: Every reference
entries.text: Also follows links and file paths mentioned in the text.

entries.title: Context view
entries.text: This file and everything it references, with token counts per part.

entries.title: Open in vertical split
entries.text: Opens the file in a new pane beside the current one.

entries.title: Open in horizontal split
entries.text: Opens the file in a new pane below the current one.

entries.title: Edit / lock
entries.text: Makes the file editable, or read only again.

entries.title: Context view
entries.text: Opens the file's context view: what it pulls in and what each part costs in tokens.

entries.title: Autosave
entries.text: Saves editable files a moment after you stop typing, never over someone else's newer save.

entries.title: Autosave after (seconds)
entries.text: How long Memory Manager waits after your last keystroke before it saves.

entries.title: Context view depth
entries.text: How many levels of references the context view follows by default.

entries.title: Memory Manager
entries.text: A Markdown browser and editor for every .md file: project docs, Claude files, repo docs and notes.

entries.title: Memory list
entries.text: Every memory file grouped by category (or location, root, kind: Settings). Filter by category, kind, where it lives, who writes it, or only what loads at session start. Scan again re-reads the code for readers and writers. Search inside memory finds words in the files' text.

entries.title: Memory chunks
entries.text: The chunked store in _claude/chunks: one chunk per Status entry, decision, thread row or doc section, with a one-line index. Sessions grep the index and read only the chunks they need. Rebuild chunks regenerates them from their sources.

entries.title: Session start
entries.text: What a session loads first: the small CLAUDE.md, then the orchestrator's list of builds started in the last 24 hours that stopped unfinished, with their next step and the chunks about them.

entries.title: Versions
entries.text: Shows “Versions”. Part of Memory Manager.

entries.title: Move or rename to
entries.text: Where you set “Move or rename to”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Memory Manager.

entries.title: Find memory files
entries.text: Where you set “Find memory files”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Memory Manager.

entries.title: Where
entries.text: Where you set “Where”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Memory Manager.

entries.title: Written by
entries.text: Where you set “Written by”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Memory Manager.

entries.title: Loaded at session start only
entries.text: Turns “Loaded at session start only” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered. Part of Memory Manager.

entries.title: Search inside memory
entries.text: Where you set “Search inside memory”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Memory Manager.

entries.title: w · r
entries.text: Shows “w · r”. Part of Memory Manager.

entries.title: Find chunks
entries.text: Where you set “Find chunks”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Memory Manager.

entries.title: Rebuild chunks
entries.text: Rebuilds chunks. Part of Memory Manager.

entries.title: Builds started in the last
entries.text: Where you set “Builds started in the last”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Memory Manager.

entries.title: Open CLAUDE.md
entries.text: Opens cLAUDE.md. Part of Memory Manager.

entries.title: Open the chunk index
entries.text: Opens the chunk index. Part of Memory Manager.

steps.say: Every Markdown file is on the left, by scope: Project, Claude, Repo and your Notes.
Tap a file to open it as a tab. Long-press it to open it in a split; drag a tab onto another pane's edge to split it yourself.
Switch Edit on to change a file. Saves never overwrite someone else's newer save, and Version history can bring back older text.
The view switch changes how everything is laid out: Browse, Read, Write or IDE.
